TL;DR

Kanaan's most popular men's spa package bundles 8 premium treatments — Moroccan bath, full body scrub, deep cleansing, massage, manicure, pedicure and more — into one relaxing session for 250 AED, available at 10 branches across Abu Dhabi.

Between work, traffic, and the pace of city life, most men in Abu Dhabi rarely slow down. A proper spa session isn't indulgence — it's how you reset, look sharper, and feel your best. The challenge is that booking each treatment separately costs more and eats up your time. That's why our most popular spa package bundles eight premium treatments into one relaxing session, for one fixed, affordable price.

Abu Dhabi's Most Popular Men's Spa Package

At Kanaan Gents Salon & Spa, our flagship spa package gives you 8 premium services for just 250 AED. It's designed as a complete head-to-toe reset: deep cleansing, exfoliation, nourishment, and pure relaxation, all in a single visit by our trained spa team.

What's Included in the 250 AED Spa Package

Each of the eight treatments is chosen to work together for visible, feel-good results:

  • Moroccan Bath with Oud & Amber — a traditional steam-and-exfoliation ritual infused with rich oud and amber for deeply clean, refreshed skin.
  • Full Body Scrub — sloughs away dead skin to leave your body smooth and revitalised.
  • Deep Skin Cleansing Cream — a deep cleanse that clears impurities and refreshes your complexion.
  • Blackhead Removal (Nose) — targeted treatment to clear and refine the nose area.
  • Hair Oil Treatment — nourishes the scalp and strengthens your hair.
  • Classic Manicure — clean, well-groomed hands and nails.
  • Pedicure — refreshed, cared-for feet.
  • 30-Minute Relaxing Massage — eases tension and leaves you fully unwound.

Why This Package Is Worth It

Booked separately, these eight treatments would cost far more and take multiple appointments to complete. As a single package, you get:

  • Exceptional value — eight premium treatments at one low price.
  • One relaxing visit — everything handled in a single session.
  • A complete reset — skin, body, hands, feet, and full relaxation covered.
  • Expert care — delivered by our experienced spa professionals.

It's a limited-time offer, so it's the perfect moment to treat yourself to the full experience.
